item.title: Recommending a Great Overseas VPS - Vultr
item.description:
Introduction to Vultr

Vultr is a well-known US cloud service provided by Choopa.com. Choopa has been providing global support services for gaming companies, so the company has deployed data centers in 14 countries and regions worldwide, including Tokyo (Japan), Singapore, Los Angeles, Seattle (USA), London (UK), Germany, and more. It offers excellent value for money, with plans starting at just $2.5/month. New users receive $25 upon registration. Click the following link to register – new users get $25 (you need to pay $10, which means you pay $10 and get $35 in credit): Promotional offer link

Advantages of Vultr

  1. Numerous data centers: 14 data centers in Japan, the US, Europe, and more.
  2. Excellent architecture: All using KVM architecture, SSD solid-state drives, starting from 1000GB/month traffic.
  3. Powerful images: Besides common Linux distributions, you can also install custom ISO systems and Windows.
  4. Powerful backend: Features including system snapshots, one-click deployment scripts, backups, firewalls, and more.
  5. Promotions: Occasional new user registration bonuses, sometimes with rewards up to $100.
  6. Flexible billing: Uses hourly billing mode, allowing you to add and remove machines at will.
  7. Customer service: Fast response times, usually getting answers within 15 minutes (time zone differences may apply).
